column10: LIONRISE PROTOCOL. The shield bends and holds. Markets reopen beneath gardens. Every species calls the tiny station home. You did not choose one strength. You built a system.
THE IRON HELM. Nothing moves without permission and nothing fails without consequence. Lionrise is the safest city in the quadrant. Its citizens whisper when the drones pass.
THE OPEN CONSTELLATION. Cargo lights form a second sunrise. Every empire needs Lionrise and none can afford to own it. The smallest state has become the galaxy's busiest room.
THE ORBITAL GARDEN. The habitat blooms faster than its towers. Refugees become citizens and citizens become inventors. Prosperity arrives softly but it stays.
THE LAST LIGHT. Lionrise survives the strike but never resolves what it wants to become. The city remains poor. Stubborn. Free. Another timeline may yet raise the sun.
